verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a developer-facing control over when content is returned, such as wait-until conditions, timeouts, or early-return options on the fetch or session APIs. The fetch feature (URL to HTML/JSON/markdown) is described without any timing controls. Auto-waits are an automatic browser-control behavior, not a latency-versus-completeness knob, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trade off latency against completeness by controlling exactly when content is returned
